Minors: source is the TDLWD summary page (Tenn. Code Ann. § 50-5-105 itself not fetchable: official code is hosted by LexisNexis). The page states 3 h/day for 14-15 while school is in session without a separate non-school-day cap, so a school-week Saturday is also capped at 3 h here; federal allows 8 h on non-school days — verify § 50-5-105 before relying on the Saturday cap.
Minors: 16-17 10 p.m. limit applies only Sun-Thu nights before a school day; enforced every night of a school week (stricter). No TN hour limits for 16-17 outside school weeks.
Minors: any minor scheduled 6 consecutive hours must get a 30-minute unpaid break, not during or before the first hour (Tenn. Code Ann. § 50-5-115); not encoded (no minor-break rule type).

rules.summary: Tennessee requires a 30-minute meal period for work over 6 hours.

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State meal-period requirements (rev. Jan. 1, 2023)
citation.excerpt: ½ hour for employees scheduled to work 6 consecutive hours or more. The meal break shall not be scheduled during or before the first hour

rules.summary: While school is in session, 14- and 15-year-olds may work at most 3 hours a day and 18 hours a week, between 7 a.m. and 7 p.m.

citation.title: TN Dept. of Labor & Workforce Development — Child Labor Act (working hours)
citation.excerpt: While School is in Session ... No more than 3 hours per day • No earlier than 7:00 am and no later than 7:00 pm • No more than 18 hours per week

rules.summary: While school is not in session, 14- and 15-year-olds may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 hours a week, between 6 a.m. and 9 p.m.

citation.title: TN Dept. of Labor & Workforce Development — Child Labor Act (working hours)
citation.excerpt: While School is Not in Session ... No more than 8 hours per day • No earlier than 6:00 am and no later than 9:00 pm • No more than 40 hours per week

rules.summary: 16- and 17-year-olds may not work during required class hours or between 10 p.m. and 6 a.m. Sunday-Thursday before a school day (until midnight up to 3 nights a week with a parental consent form).

citation.title: TN Dept. of Labor & Workforce Development — Child Labor Act (working hours)
citation.excerpt: Minors 16 and 17 years of age may not be employed between the hours of 10:00 pm and 6:00 am, Sunday through Thursday, preceding a school day. Tenn. Code Ann. §50-5-105(b)(2).
